items.tip: Соблюдай паузу между массовыми запросами и сохраняй результаты локально.

items.name: Carbon Interface
items.summary: Carbon emission estimates for electricity, flights, shipping and vehicles.
items.tip: Estimates use published emission factors, so document the methodology if you display figures to users.

localizedSummary.en: Carbon emission estimates for electricity, flights, shipping and vehicles.

items.name: Crossref REST API
items.summary: Метаданные научных публикаций и DOI из открытого реестра Crossref.

items.name: DataCite REST API
items.summary: Metadata for research datasets, software and preprints registered with DOIs.

localizedTip.en: Complements Crossref: DataCite covers datasets and software, Crossref covers journal articles.

items.name: EIA Open Data
items.summary: US Energy Information Administration data on production, consumption and prices.
items.tip: Series IDs are the primary lookup key — browse the catalog first rather than guessing identifiers.

localizedSummary.en: US Energy Information Administration data on production, consumption and prices.
localizedSummary.ru: Данные Управления энергетической информации США о добыче, потреблении и ценах.

localizedTip.en: Series IDs are the primary lookup key — browse the catalog first rather than guessing identifiers.

items.name: Electricity Maps
items.summary: Real-time carbon intensity and electricity mix data by geographic zone.
items.tip: Useful for carbon-aware scheduling — shift batch jobs to hours when the grid is cleanest.

localizedSummary.en: Real-time carbon intensity and electricity mix data by geographic zone.
localizedSummary.ru: Данные об углеродоёмкости и структуре электрогенерации по географическим зонам в реальном времени.

localizedTip.en: Useful for carbon-aware scheduling — shift batch jobs to hours when the grid is cleanest.

items.name: Europe PMC API
items.summary: Биомедицинские статьи, цитирования и полнотекстовые материалы Europe PMC.

items.name: Figshare API
items.summary: Upload, publish and cite research data and figures with a DOI.
items.tip: Every published item gets a citable DOI automatically — useful for data that needs to be formally cited.

localizedSummary.en: Upload, publish and cite research data and figures with a DOI.
localizedSummary.ru: Загрузка, публикация и цитирование исследовательских данных и рисунков с DOI.

localizedTip.en: Every published item gets a citable DOI automatically — useful for data that needs to be formally cited.

items.name: GBIF
items.summary: Global biodiversity data: species occurrence records from museums and surveys worldwide.
items.tip: Occurrence downloads are asynchronous for large queries — request, then poll for the prepared archive.

localizedSummary.en: Global biodiversity data: species occurrence records from museums and surveys worldwide.
localizedSummary.ru: Глобальные данные о биоразнообразии: записи о встречах видов из музеев и исследований по всему миру.

localizedTip.en: Occurrence downloads are asynchronous for large queries — request, then poll for the prepared archive.

items.name: iNaturalist API
items.summary: Species observations with photos from a global citizen science network.

localizedSummary.en: Species observations with photos from a global citizen science network.

localizedTip.en: Filter by quality_grade=research if you need identifications you can actually trust.

items.name: NCBI E-utilities
items.summary: Programmatic access to PubMed, GenBank and the rest of NCBI's biomedical databases.
items.tip: Register an API key even though it's optional — it triples your rate limit for free.

localizedSummary.en: Programmatic access to PubMed, GenBank and the rest of NCBI's biomedical databases.

localizedTip.en: Register an API key even though it's optional — it triples your rate limit for free.

items.name: NOAA APIs
items.summary: US government weather, climate and ocean data, no key required.

localizedTip.en: Grid-point forecasts are more precise than city-level ones — resolve coordinates to a grid point first.

items.name: OpenAlex API
items.summary: Открытый граф научных работ, авторов, организаций, тем и цитирований.

items.name: ORCID API
items.summary: Persistent researcher identifiers linking people to their publications and affiliations.
items.tip: Public API access needs no auth for reading a researcher's public record.

localizedSummary.en: Persistent researcher identifiers linking people to their publications and affiliations.

items.name: Semantic Scholar API
items.summary: Научные статьи, авторы, ссылки и рекомендации; базовый доступ возможен без ключа.

items.name: USGS Earthquake API
items.summary: Real time and historical earthquake feeds in GeoJSON.

localizedTip.en: The ready-made GeoJSON summary feeds drop straight into Leaflet with zero transformation.

items.name: USGS Water Services
items.summary: Real-time river, lake and groundwater monitoring data across the US.

localizedSummary.en: Real-time river, lake and groundwater monitoring data across the US.

localizedTip.en: Site numbers are the stable identifier — resolve a location to its nearest gauge site once and cache it.

items.name: ATTOM Data
items.summary: Deep US property data: tax assessments, sales history, foreclosure status.

items.name: Bridge Interactive (Zillow)
items.summary: MLS listing data feed used by many real-estate platforms, including Zillow syndication.

items.name: RentCast
items.summary: Property records, rent estimates and market data via a straightforward REST API.

items.name: Canvas LMS API

localizedTip.en: A free developer instance is available for testing without touching a real institution's data.

items.name: Google Classroom API

items.name: Open edX APIs

items.name: Cloudflare Radar

items.name: TiDB

items.tip: Its HTAP design runs analytics on a columnar replica without touching transactional performance.

localizedSummary.en: Distributed MySQL-compatible database supporting both transactional and analytical queries.
localizedSummary.ru: Распределённая MySQL-совместимая база, поддерживающая транзакционные и аналитические запросы.

localizedTip.en: Its HTAP design runs analytics on a columnar replica without touching transactional performance.

items.name: TypeORM
items.summary: TypeScript ORM supporting both Active Record and Data Mapper patterns.
items.tip: Pick Data Mapper (repositories) over Active Record for anything beyond a small project — it tests more easily.

localizedSummary.en: TypeScript ORM supporting both Active Record and Data Mapper patterns.
localizedSummary.ru: TypeScript ORM с поддержкой паттернов Active Record и Data Mapper.

localizedTip.en: Pick Data Mapper (repositories) over Active Record for anything beyond a small project — it tests more easily.

items.name: YugabyteDB
items.summary: Distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL wire compatibility.
items.tip: Reuses the actual PostgreSQL query layer, so extension and syntax support is unusually complete.

localizedSummary.en: Distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL wire compatibility.
localizedSummary.ru: Распределённая SQL-база с совместимостью по протоколу PostgreSQL.

localizedTip.en: Reuses the actual PostgreSQL query layer, so extension and syntax support is unusually complete.

items.name: Redis
items.summary: In-memory data store for caching, queues and pub/sub.
items.tip: Always set a TTL on cache keys: unbounded cache growth is the classic production incident.

localizedSummary.en: In-memory data store for caching, queues and pub/sub.
localizedSummary.ru: In-memory хранилище для кэша, очередей и pub/sub.

localizedTip.en: Always set a TTL on cache keys: unbounded cache growth is the classic production incident.

items.name: Agenda
items.summary: MongoDB-backed job scheduling for Node.
items.tip: Useful when you already run MongoDB and would rather not add Redis for queues alone.

localizedSummary.en: MongoDB-backed job scheduling for Node.
localizedSummary.ru: Планирование задач для Node на основе MongoDB.

localizedTip.en: Useful when you already run MongoDB and would rather not add Redis for queues alone.

items.name: arq
items.summary: Async job queue for Python built on asyncio and Redis, lighter than Celery.
items.tip: A natural fit when your app is already fully async — Celery's sync-first model fights asyncio codebases.

localizedSummary.en: Async job queue for Python built on asyncio and Redis, lighter than Celery.
localizedSummary.ru: Асинхронная очередь задач для Python на asyncio и Redis, легче Celery.

localizedTip.en: A natural fit when your app is already fully async — Celery's sync-first model fights asyncio codebases.

items.name: Asynq
items.summary: Simple, reliable Redis-backed task queue for Go with a web dashboard.
items.tip: Its dashboard makes inspecting and retrying failed jobs straightforward without extra tooling.

localizedSummary.en: Simple, reliable Redis-backed task queue for Go with a web dashboard.
localizedSummary.ru: Простая надёжная очередь задач для Go на Redis с веб-дашбордом.

localizedTip.en: Its dashboard makes inspecting and retrying failed jobs straightforward without extra tooling.

items.name: AWS Step Functions
items.summary: Managed state machine orchestration across AWS services.
items.tip: Express workflows cost far less than standard ones for short high-volume executions.

localizedSummary.en: Managed state machine orchestration across AWS services.
localizedSummary.ru: Управляемая оркестрация конечных автоматов между сервисами AWS.

localizedTip.en: Express workflows cost far less than standard ones for short high-volume executions.

items.name: Azure Durable Functions
items.summary: Stateful serverless orchestration written as ordinary code on Azure Functions.
items.tip: Orchestrator code must be deterministic — replays re-execute it from the start every time.

localizedSummary.en: Stateful serverless orchestration written as ordinary code on Azure Functions.
localizedSummary.ru: Serverless-оркестрация с состоянием, написанная обычным кодом на Azure Functions.

localizedTip.en: Orchestrator code must be deterministic — replays re-execute it from the start every time.

items.name: Bee-Queue
items.summary: Fast Redis-backed job queue for Node, focused on short live jobs.
items.tip: Optimized for throughput on short jobs where BullMQ's richer features are unnecessary.

localizedSummary.en: Fast Redis-backed job queue for Node, focused on short live jobs.
localizedSummary.ru: Быстрая очередь задач для Node на Redis, ориентированная на короткие задачи.

localizedTip.en: Optimized for throughput on short jobs where BullMQ's richer features are unnecessary.

items.name: BullMQ
items.summary: Redis-backed job queues for Node with retries, repeatable jobs and flows.
items.tip: Make handlers idempotent: at-least-once delivery means a job will run twice one day.

localizedSummary.en: Redis-backed job queues for Node with retries, repeatable jobs and flows.
localizedSummary.ru: Очереди задач на Redis для Node с повторами, периодическими задачами и flows.

localizedTip.en: Make handlers idempotent: at-least-once delivery means a job will run twice one day.

items.name: Cadence
items.summary: Fault-tolerant workflow orchestration engine from Uber.
items.tip: Temporal was forked from it and carries most of the community — check both before choosing.

localizedSummary.en: Fault-tolerant workflow orchestration engine from Uber.
localizedSummary.ru: Отказоустойчивый движок оркестрации workflow от Uber.

localizedTip.en: Temporal was forked from it and carries most of the community — check both before choosing.

items.name: Camunda 8 (Zeebe)
items.summary: Horizontally scalable BPMN workflow engine behind Camunda 8.
items.tip: Its event-sourced design handles far higher process throughput than the older Camunda 7 engine.

localizedSummary.en: Horizontally scalable BPMN workflow engine behind Camunda 8.
localizedSummary.ru: Горизонтально масштабируемый BPMN-движок workflow, лежащий в основе Camunda 8.

localizedTip.en: Its event-sourced design handles far higher process throughput than the older Camunda 7 engine.

items.name: Celery
items.summary: The long-standing Python task queue for background and scheduled work.
items.tip: Set explicit time limits and acks_late, or one stuck task quietly holds a worker forever.

localizedSummary.en: The long-standing Python task queue for background and scheduled work.
localizedSummary.ru: Проверенная временем очередь задач Python для фоновой и периодической работы.

localizedTip.en: Set explicit time limits and acks_late, or one stuck task quietly holds a worker forever.

items.name: Celery Beat
items.summary: The periodic-task scheduler that ships with Celery, a distributed cron replacement.
items.tip: Run exactly one beat process cluster-wide, or every scheduled task fires once per beat instance.

localizedSummary.en: The periodic-task scheduler that ships with Celery, a distributed cron replacement.
localizedSummary.ru: Планировщик периодических задач в составе Celery — распределённая замена cron.

localizedTip.en: Run exactly one beat process cluster-wide, or every scheduled task fires once per beat instance.

items.name: Centrifugo
items.summary: Standalone realtime messaging server usable from any backend language.
items.tip: Running it beside an existing backend adds realtime without rewriting anything in Node.

localizedSummary.en: Standalone realtime messaging server usable from any backend language.
localizedSummary.ru: Автономный сервер realtime-сообщений, используемый из любого языка бэкенда.

localizedTip.en: Running it beside an existing backend adds realtime without rewriting anything in Node.

items.name: Cloudflare Queues
items.summary: Managed message queues integrated with Cloudflare Workers.
items.tip: Batched consumers reduce invocation count, which is what keeps serverless queue costs low.

localizedSummary.en: Managed message queues integrated with Cloudflare Workers.
localizedSummary.ru: Управляемые очереди сообщений, интегрированные с Cloudflare Workers.

localizedTip.en: Batched consumers reduce invocation count, which is what keeps serverless queue costs low.

items.name: Cloudflare Workflows
items.summary: Durable multi-step workflows running on Cloudflare Workers.
items.tip: Each step's result is persisted, so a workflow resumes mid-run rather than restarting.

localizedSummary.en: Durable multi-step workflows running on Cloudflare Workers.
localizedSummary.ru: Надёжные многошаговые workflow, выполняемые на Cloudflare Workers.

localizedTip.en: Each step's result is persisted, so a workflow resumes mid-run rather than restarting.

items.name: Conductor
items.summary: Microservice orchestration engine originally built at Netflix.
items.tip: Workflows are JSON definitions, so non-developers can review the orchestration logic.

localizedSummary.en: Microservice orchestration engine originally built at Netflix.
localizedSummary.ru: Движок оркестрации микросервисов, изначально созданный в Netflix.

localizedTip.en: Workflows are JSON definitions, so non-developers can review the orchestration logic.

items.name: DBOS
items.summary: Durable execution as a library, storing workflow state in Postgres.
items.tip: It is a library, not a cluster, so a crashed process resumes without operating a workflow service.

localizedSummary.en: Durable execution as a library, storing workflow state in Postgres.
localizedSummary.ru: Durable execution в виде библиотеки, хранящей состояние workflow в Postgres.

localizedTip.en: It is a library, not a cluster, so a crashed process resumes without operating a workflow service.

items.name: Dramatiq
items.summary: Python task processing library emphasising reliability and simplicity.
items.tip: Its defaults around retries and acknowledgement are safer than Celery's out of the box.

localizedSummary.en: Python task processing library emphasising reliability and simplicity.
localizedSummary.ru: Библиотека обработки задач Python с упором на надёжность и простоту.

localizedTip.en: Its defaults around retries and acknowledgement are safer than Celery's out of the box.

items.name: Faktory
items.summary: Language-agnostic background job server from the author of Sidekiq.
items.tip: Workers in different languages share one queue, which per-language libraries cannot do.

localizedSummary.en: Language-agnostic background job server from the author of Sidekiq.
localizedSummary.ru: Языконезависимый сервер фоновых задач от автора Sidekiq.

localizedTip.en: Workers in different languages share one queue, which per-language libraries cannot do.

items.name: Golem
items.summary: Durable computing platform running WebAssembly components that survive restarts.
items.tip: WASM state snapshotting means ordinary code becomes durable without workflow-specific structuring.

localizedSummary.en: Durable computing platform running WebAssembly components that survive restarts.
localizedSummary.ru: Платформа durable-вычислений, запускающая WebAssembly-компоненты, переживающие перезапуски.

localizedTip.en: WASM state snapshotting means ordinary code becomes durable without workflow-specific structuring.

items.name: Google Cloud Workflows
items.summary: Serverless orchestration of Google Cloud and HTTP services defined in YAML.
items.tip: Billed per step, so a chatty workflow costs more than one that batches its calls.

localizedSummary.en: Serverless orchestration of Google Cloud and HTTP services defined in YAML.
localizedSummary.ru: Serverless-оркестрация сервисов Google Cloud и HTTP, описанная в YAML.

localizedTip.en: Billed per step, so a chatty workflow costs more than one that batches its calls.

items.name: Graphile Worker
items.summary: Postgres-backed job queue for Node with very low latency.
items.tip: Using LISTEN/NOTIFY rather than polling is what keeps latency in milliseconds.

localizedSummary.en: Postgres-backed job queue for Node with very low latency.
localizedSummary.ru: Очередь задач для Node на Postgres с очень низкой задержкой.

localizedTip.en: Using LISTEN/NOTIFY rather than polling is what keeps latency in milliseconds.

items.name: Hatchet
items.summary: Postgres-backed distributed task queue with durable DAG workflows.
items.tip: Combines a queue and a workflow engine, which usually means running two separate systems.

localizedSummary.en: Postgres-backed distributed task queue with durable DAG workflows.
localizedSummary.ru: Распределённая очередь задач на Postgres с надёжными DAG-workflow.

localizedTip.en: Combines a queue and a workflow engine, which usually means running two separate systems.

items.name: Huey
items.summary: Lightweight Python task queue with periodic task support.
items.tip: Small enough to read end to end, which makes debugging queue behaviour genuinely feasible.

localizedSummary.en: Lightweight Python task queue with periodic task support.
localizedSummary.ru: Лёгкая очередь задач Python с поддержкой периодических задач.

localizedTip.en: Small enough to read end to end, which makes debugging queue behaviour genuinely feasible.

items.name: Inngest
items.summary: Event-driven durable functions with steps and no queue to operate.
items.tip: Each step is checkpointed, so a retry resumes rather than restarting the whole function.

localizedSummary.en: Event-driven durable functions with steps and no queue to operate.
localizedSummary.ru: Событийные durable-функции со шагами и без очереди, которую нужно обслуживать.

localizedTip.en: Each step is checkpointed, so a retry resumes rather than restarting the whole function.

items.name: Kafka Streams
items.summary: Java library for stateful stream processing directly on Kafka topics.
items.tip: It is a library, not a cluster — your app is the processor, which removes a whole deployment tier.

localizedSummary.en: Java library for stateful stream processing directly on Kafka topics.

items.name: Machinery
items.summary: Distributed task queue for Go supporting several broker backends.
items.tip: Its chains and chords express multi-step job workflows without a separate orchestrator.

localizedSummary.en: Distributed task queue for Go supporting several broker backends.
localizedSummary.ru: Распределённая очередь задач для Go с поддержкой нескольких брокеров.

localizedTip.en: Its chains and chords express multi-step job workflows without a separate orchestrator.

items.name: Mercure
items.summary: Open protocol for server-sent updates, built on Server-Sent Events.
items.tip: Simpler than WebSocket when updates only flow from server to client.

localizedSummary.en: Open protocol for server-sent updates, built on Server-Sent Events.
localizedSummary.ru: Открытый протокол серверных обновлений на основе Server-Sent Events.

localizedTip.en: Simpler than WebSocket when updates only flow from server to client.

items.name: pg-boss
items.summary: Job queue for Node built entirely on Postgres.
items.tip: Enqueuing inside the same transaction as your data change removes a whole class of consistency bug.

localizedSummary.en: Job queue for Node built entirely on Postgres.
localizedSummary.ru: Очередь задач для Node, полностью построенная на Postgres.

localizedTip.en: Enqueuing inside the same transaction as your data change removes a whole class of consistency bug.

items.name: PubNub
items.summary: Managed realtime messaging network with global points of presence.
items.tip: Its global edge network keeps latency low for geographically spread users.

localizedTip.en: Its global edge network keeps latency low for geographically spread users.

items.name: Redpanda Connect (Benthos)
items.summary: Declarative stream processor connecting queues, databases and APIs with YAML pipelines.

localizedSummary.ru: Декларативный потоковый процессор, связывающий очереди, базы и API через YAML-пайплайны.

items.name: Resonate
items.summary: Durable promises making distributed async calls resumable after failure.
items.tip: The promise abstraction is far smaller to learn than a full workflow DSL.

localizedSummary.en: Durable promises making distributed async calls resumable after failure.
localizedSummary.ru: Durable promises, делающие распределённые асинхронные вызовы восстанавливаемыми после сбоя.

items.name: River
items.summary: Postgres-backed job queue for Go with transactional enqueueing.

localizedTip.en: Its transactional guarantee means a job never runs for a transaction that rolled back.

items.name: RQ
items.summary: Simple Python job queue backed by Redis.

localizedTip.en: Far less to configure than Celery when you only need to run functions in the background.

items.name: Sidekiq
items.summary: The standard background job processor for Ruby, backed by Redis.

items.name: Sidekiq Enterprise

localizedSummary.ru: Коммерческий уровень Sidekiq с ограничением частоты, батчами и надёжной выборкой.

localizedTip.en: Reliable fetch is the feature that prevents job loss when a worker is killed mid-job.

items.name: Soketi
items.summary: Self-hosted WebSocket server compatible with the Pusher protocol.

items.name: Adapty
items.summary: Subscription infrastructure with remotely configurable paywalls and A/B testing.

localizedSummary.ru: Инфраструктура подписок с удалённо настраиваемыми paywall и A/B-тестированием.

items.name: Qonversion
items.summary: Subscription management with revenue analytics and user segmentation.

localizedTip.en: Combines the entitlement layer with cohort revenue reporting, avoiding a second analytics tool.

items.name: RevenueCat SDK

items.name: Superwall

items.name: Maizzle

items.name: MJML

items.name: Nodemailer

items.name: Apollo Client

items.name: Dexie.js

items.name: Hocuspocus

items.tip: Use the Kotlin DSL for new builds — the type safety catches script errors the Groovy DSL hides.

localizedSummary.en: Flexible JVM build tool with incremental builds and a build cache.
localizedSummary.ru: Гибкий инструмент сборки для JVM с инкрементальными сборками и кэшем сборки.

localizedTip.en: Use the Kotlin DSL for new builds — the type safety catches script errors the Groovy DSL hides.

items.name: jOOQ
items.summary: Type-safe SQL query building for Java, generated directly from your database schema.
items.tip: Schema changes surface as compile errors in queries that reference the changed column — no silent runtime breaks.

localizedSummary.en: Type-safe SQL query building for Java, generated directly from your database schema.
localizedSummary.ru: Типобезопасное построение SQL-запросов для Java, генерируется прямо из схемы базы данных.

localizedTip.en: Schema changes surface as compile errors in queries that reference the changed column — no silent runtime breaks.

items.name: Kotlin Coroutines
items.summary: Kotlin's structured concurrency model for asynchronous programming.
items.tip: Scopes tie coroutine lifetime to a component's lifecycle, which prevents the classic leaked-async-task bug.

localizedSummary.en: Kotlin's structured concurrency model for asynchronous programming.
localizedSummary.ru: Модель структурированной конкурентности Kotlin для асинхронного программирования.

localizedTip.en: Scopes tie coroutine lifetime to a component's lifecycle, which prevents the classic leaked-async-task bug.

items.name: kotlinx.serialization
items.summary: Kotlin's official multiplatform serialization library.
items.tip: Compiler-plugin based, so it needs no reflection and works on Kotlin/Native too.

localizedSummary.en: Kotlin's official multiplatform serialization library.
localizedSummary.ru: Официальная мультиплатформенная библиотека сериализации Kotlin.

localizedTip.en: Compiler-plugin based, so it needs no reflection and works on Kotlin/Native too.

items.name: ktlint
items.summary: Kotlin linter and formatter following the official style guide.
items.tip: Following the official guide avoids a per-team style debate that never actually converges.

localizedSummary.en: Kotlin linter and formatter following the official style guide.
localizedSummary.ru: Линтер и форматтер Kotlin по официальному руководству по стилю.

localizedTip.en: Following the official guide avoids a per-team style debate that never actually converges.

items.name: Ktor Client
items.summary: Multiplatform HTTP client for Kotlin, built on coroutines.
items.tip: The same client code runs on Android, iOS and the JVM, which is the point of Kotlin Multiplatform.

localizedSummary.en: Multiplatform HTTP client for Kotlin, built on coroutines.
localizedSummary.ru: Мультиплатформенный HTTP-клиент для Kotlin на корутинах.

localizedTip.en: The same client code runs on Android, iOS and the JVM, which is the point of Kotlin Multiplatform.

items.name: Micronaut
items.summary: JVM framework using compile-time dependency injection for fast startup, no reflection at runtime.
items.tip: Compile-time DI is why startup and memory footprint beat traditional Spring in serverless contexts.

localizedSummary.en: JVM framework using compile-time dependency injection for fast startup, no reflection at runtime.
localizedSummary.ru: JVM-фреймворк с DI на этапе компиляции для быстрого старта без рефлексии в рантайме.

localizedTip.en: Compile-time DI is why startup and memory footprint beat traditional Spring in serverless contexts.

items.name: Mill
items.summary: JVM build tool aiming for simpler, more predictable builds than sbt.
items.tip: Its build files are plain Scala objects, which makes build logic far easier to follow than sbt's DSL.

localizedSummary.en: JVM build tool aiming for simpler, more predictable builds than sbt.
localizedSummary.ru: Инструмент сборки для JVM, стремящийся к более простым и предсказуемым сборкам, чем sbt.

localizedTip.en: Its build files are plain Scala objects, which makes build logic far easier to follow than sbt's DSL.

items.name: Moshi
items.summary: Modern JSON library for Kotlin and Java with code generation.
items.tip: It understands Kotlin nullability, which Gson silently violates at runtime.

localizedSummary.en: Modern JSON library for Kotlin and Java with code generation.
localizedSummary.ru: Современная JSON-библиотека для Kotlin и Java с кодогенерацией.

localizedTip.en: It understands Kotlin nullability, which Gson silently violates at runtime.

items.name: OkHttp
items.summary: Efficient HTTP client underlying Retrofit and much of the Android ecosystem.
items.tip: Its interceptors are where logging, auth and retry logic belong, rather than in each call site.

localizedSummary.en: Efficient HTTP client underlying Retrofit and much of the Android ecosystem.
localizedSummary.ru: Эффективный HTTP-клиент, лежащий в основе Retrofit и большей части экосистемы Android.

localizedTip.en: Its interceptors are where logging, auth and retry logic belong, rather than in each call site.

items.name: OpenRewrite
items.summary: Automated large-scale refactoring for JVM projects, driven by reusable recipes.
items.tip: Its framework migration recipes handle Spring Boot upgrades that would otherwise be manual work.

localizedSummary.en: Automated large-scale refactoring for JVM projects, driven by reusable recipes.
localizedSummary.ru: Автоматический масштабный рефакторинг JVM-проектов на основе переиспользуемых рецептов.

localizedTip.en: Its framework migration recipes handle Spring Boot upgrades that would otherwise be manual work.

items.name: PMD
items.summary: Source code analyzer for many languages, including copy-paste detection.
items.tip: Its copy-paste detector finds duplication across files that ordinary linters never compare.

localizedSummary.en: Source code analyzer for many languages, including copy-paste detection.
localizedSummary.ru: Анализатор исходного кода для многих языков, включая обнаружение копипаста.

localizedTip.en: Its copy-paste detector finds duplication across files that ordinary linters never compare.

items.name: Quarkus
items.summary: Kubernetes-native Java framework optimized for fast startup and low memory via GraalVM.
items.tip: Native compilation via GraalVM cuts startup to milliseconds — worth it specifically for serverless Java.

localizedSummary.en: Kubernetes-native Java framework optimized for fast startup and low memory via GraalVM.
localizedSummary.ru: Java-фреймворк, нативный для Kubernetes, оптимизирован под быстрый старт и низкую память через GraalVM.

localizedTip.en: Native compilation via GraalVM cuts startup to milliseconds — worth it specifically for serverless Java.

items.name: Quartz Scheduler
items.summary: Mature Java job scheduling library with clustering support.
items.tip: Clustered mode ensures a scheduled job fires once across instances, not once per instance.

localizedSummary.en: Mature Java job scheduling library with clustering support.
localizedSummary.ru: Зрелая библиотека планирования задач для Java с поддержкой кластеризации.

localizedTip.en: Clustered mode ensures a scheduled job fires once across instances, not once per instance.

items.name: REST Assured
items.summary: Fluent Java DSL for testing REST services.
items.tip: Its given/when/then chaining keeps API assertions readable inside ordinary JUnit tests.

localizedSummary.en: Fluent Java DSL for testing REST services.
localizedSummary.ru: Текучий Java-DSL для тестирования REST-сервисов.

localizedTip.en: Its given/when/then chaining keeps API assertions readable inside ordinary JUnit tests.

items.name: Retrofit
items.summary: Type-safe HTTP client for Android and Java, defined with annotations.
items.tip: An annotated interface replaces the request-building code entirely.

localizedSummary.en: Type-safe HTTP client for Android and Java, defined with annotations.
localizedSummary.ru: Типобезопасный HTTP-клиент для Android и Java, описываемый аннотациями.

localizedTip.en: An annotated interface replaces the request-building code entirely.

items.name: sbt
items.summary: The standard Scala build tool, with incremental compilation and an interactive shell.
items.tip: Keeping its shell open avoids repeated JVM startup, which dominates short Scala build times.

localizedSummary.en: The standard Scala build tool, with incremental compilation and an interactive shell.
localizedSummary.ru: Стандартный инструмент сборки Scala с инкрементальной компиляцией и интерактивной оболочкой.

localizedTip.en: Keeping its shell open avoids repeated JVM startup, which dominates short Scala build times.

items.name: SpotBugs
items.summary: Finds bug patterns in Java bytecode, the successor to FindBugs.
items.tip: Analyzing bytecode means it also inspects dependencies you have no source for.

localizedSummary.en: Finds bug patterns in Java bytecode, the successor to FindBugs.
localizedSummary.ru: Находит шаблоны ошибок в байткоде Java, преемник FindBugs.

localizedTip.en: Analyzing bytecode means it also inspects dependencies you have no source for.

items.name: Spring Batch
items.summary: Batch processing framework for large-volume JVM jobs.
items.tip: Chunk-based processing with restart from the last checkpoint is what suits it to very long jobs.

localizedSummary.en: Batch processing framework for large-volume JVM jobs.
localizedSummary.ru: Фреймворк пакетной обработки для крупных задач на JVM.

localizedTip.en: Chunk-based processing with restart from the last checkpoint is what suits it to very long jobs.

items.name: Spring Boot
items.summary: Convention-over-configuration framework that makes Spring's Java ecosystem approachable.
items.tip: Spring Initializr generates a working starter project in seconds — start there, not from a blank repo.

localizedSummary.en: Convention-over-configuration framework that makes Spring's Java ecosystem approachable.
localizedSummary.ru: Фреймворк convention-over-configuration, делающий экосистему Spring для Java доступной.

localizedTip.en: Spring Initializr generates a working starter project in seconds — start there, not from a blank repo.

items.name: Spring Cloud Contract
items.summary: Contract testing and stub generation for Spring-based services.
items.tip: Generates both the provider test and the consumer stub from one contract definition.

localizedSummary.en: Contract testing and stub generation for Spring-based services.
localizedSummary.ru: Контрактное тестирование и генерация заглушек для сервисов на Spring.

localizedTip.en: Generates both the provider test and the consumer stub from one contract definition.

items.name: Spring Security
items.summary: Comprehensive authentication and authorization for Spring applications.
items.tip: Powerful and easy to misconfigure — its filter chain rewards reading the reference properly.

localizedSummary.en: Comprehensive authentication and authorization for Spring applications.
localizedSummary.ru: Полноценная аутентификация и авторизация для приложений Spring.

localizedTip.en: Powerful and easy to misconfigure — its filter chain rewards reading the reference properly.

items.name: Actix Web
items.summary: High-performance async web framework for Rust.
items.tip: Consistently near the top of web framework benchmarks, but check ecosystem maturity for your specific need.

localizedSummary.en: High-performance async web framework for Rust.
localizedSummary.ru: Высокопроизводительный асинхронный веб-фреймворк для Rust.

localizedTip.en: Consistently near the top of web framework benchmarks, but check ecosystem maturity for your specific need.

items.name: Axum
items.summary: Ergonomic Rust web framework built by the Tokio team on top of Tower.
items.tip: Tower middleware works unmodified here, so the ecosystem is bigger than it first appears.

localizedSummary.en: Ergonomic Rust web framework built by the Tokio team on top of Tower.
localizedSummary.ru: Эргономичный веб-фреймворк Rust от команды Tokio, построен поверх Tower.

localizedTip.en: Tower middleware works unmodified here, so the ecosystem is bigger than it first appears.

items.name: Cargo
items.summary: Rust's official build tool and package manager.
items.tip: Widely treated as the reference design for what a language's package manager should be.

localizedSummary.en: Rust's official build tool and package manager.
localizedSummary.ru: Официальный инструмент сборки и менеджер пакетов Rust.

localizedTip.en: Widely treated as the reference design for what a language's package manager should be.

items.name: Clippy
items.summary: Official Rust linter with hundreds of idiom and correctness lints.
items.tip: It teaches idiomatic Rust as you go, which makes it valuable well beyond catching bugs.

localizedSummary.en: Official Rust linter with hundreds of idiom and correctness lints.
localizedSummary.ru: Официальный линтер Rust с сотнями правил идиоматичности и корректности.

localizedTip.en: It teaches idiomatic Rust as you go, which makes it valuable well beyond catching bugs.

items.name: Leptos
items.summary: Full-stack Rust web framework compiling to WebAssembly, with fine-grained reactivity.
items.tip: Isomorphic server functions let one function definition run seamlessly on both server and client.

localizedSummary.en: Full-stack Rust web framework compiling to WebAssembly, with fine-grained reactivity.
localizedSummary.ru: Full-stack веб-фреймворк Rust с компиляцией в WebAssembly и тонкозернистой реактивностью.

localizedTip.en: Isomorphic server functions let one function definition run seamlessly on both server and client.

items.name: Rocket
items.summary: Ergonomic Rust web framework emphasizing type safety and minimal boilerplate.
items.tip: Request guards catch invalid requests at the type level before your handler code even runs.

localizedSummary.en: Ergonomic Rust web framework emphasizing type safety and minimal boilerplate.
localizedSummary.ru: Эргономичный веб-фреймворк Rust с акцентом на типобезопасность и минимум шаблонного кода.

localizedTip.en: Request guards catch invalid requests at the type level before your handler code even runs.

items.name: rustfmt
items.summary: The official Rust code formatter.
items.tip: Near-universal adoption means Rust code looks the same across essentially every project.

localizedSummary.en: The official Rust code formatter.
localizedSummary.ru: Официальный форматтер кода Rust.

localizedTip.en: Near-universal adoption means Rust code looks the same across essentially every project.

items.name: Serde
items.summary: The standard Rust serialization framework, powering nearly every JSON/YAML/etc. use case.
items.tip: The derive macro generates (de)serialization code at compile time — no runtime reflection cost.

localizedSummary.en: The standard Rust serialization framework, powering nearly every JSON/YAML/etc. use case.
localizedSummary.ru: Стандартный фреймворк сериализации Rust, лежит в основе почти любой работы с JSON/YAML.

localizedTip.en: The derive macro generates (de)serialization code at compile time — no runtime reflection cost.

items.name: SQLx
items.summary: Async SQL toolkit that checks your queries against the real database schema at compile time.
items.tip: Run cargo sqlx prepare before CI without a live database connection — it caches query metadata for that.

localizedSummary.en: Async SQL toolkit that checks your queries against the real database schema at compile time.
localizedSummary.ru: Асинхронный SQL-тулкит, проверяющий запросы по реальной схеме базы данных на этапе компиляции.

localizedTip.en: Run cargo sqlx prepare before CI without a live database connection — it caches query metadata for that.

items.name: Tokio
items.summary: The async runtime nearly all networked Rust applications are built on.
items.tip: Enable only the feature flags you need — the full feature set adds real compile-time cost.

localizedSummary.en: The async runtime nearly all networked Rust applications are built on.
localizedSummary.ru: Асинхронный рантайм, на котором построены почти все сетевые приложения на Rust.

localizedTip.en: Enable only the feature flags you need — the full feature set adds real compile-time cost.

items.name: Apache ZooKeeper
items.summary: Distributed coordination service for configuration and locking.
items.tip: Kafka and HBase have historically depended on it, though both are moving away.

localizedSummary.en: Distributed coordination service for configuration and locking.
localizedSummary.ru: Служба распределённой координации для конфигурации и блокировок.

localizedTip.en: Kafka and HBase have historically depended on it, though both are moving away.

items.name: Argo Rollouts
items.summary: Progressive delivery controller for canary and blue-green Kubernetes deployments.
items.tip: Automated rollback on metric regression is the part that makes canaries safe to run unattended.

localizedSummary.en: Progressive delivery controller for canary and blue-green Kubernetes deployments.
localizedSummary.ru: Контроллер прогрессивной доставки для canary и blue-green развёртываний в Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Automated rollback on metric regression is the part that makes canaries safe to run unattended.

items.name: Argo Workflows
items.summary: Container-native workflow engine running DAGs of steps on Kubernetes.
items.tip: Every step is a container, which makes polyglot pipelines trivial compared to a single-language runner.

localizedSummary.en: Container-native workflow engine running DAGs of steps on Kubernetes.
localizedSummary.ru: Нативный для контейнеров движок workflow, выполняющий DAG шагов в Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Every step is a container, which makes polyglot pipelines trivial compared to a single-language runner.

items.name: Calico
items.summary: Widely deployed Kubernetes CNI with mature network policy enforcement.
items.tip: The conservative default when you want proven policy enforcement rather than eBPF's newer capabilities.

localizedSummary.en: Widely deployed Kubernetes CNI with mature network policy enforcement.
localizedSummary.ru: Широко распространённый CNI для Kubernetes со зрелым применением сетевых политик.

localizedTip.en: The conservative default when you want proven policy enforcement rather than eBPF's newer capabilities.

items.name: cert-manager
items.summary: Automates TLS certificate issuance and renewal inside Kubernetes.
items.tip: Set up a staging ClusterIssuer first — Let's Encrypt production rate limits are easy to hit while debugging.

localizedSummary.en: Automates TLS certificate issuance and renewal inside Kubernetes.
localizedSummary.ru: Автоматизирует выпуск и обновление TLS-сертификатов внутри Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Set up a staging ClusterIssuer first — Let's Encrypt production rate limits are easy to hit while debugging.

items.name: Cilium
items.summary: eBPF-based Kubernetes networking, security policy and observability.
items.tip: Its Hubble component gives network flow visibility that traditional CNIs simply cannot provide.

localizedSummary.en: eBPF-based Kubernetes networking, security policy and observability.
localizedSummary.ru: Сетевой стек Kubernetes на eBPF с политиками безопасности и наблюдаемостью.

localizedTip.en: Its Hubble component gives network flow visibility that traditional CNIs simply cannot provide.

items.name: Cluster Autoscaler
items.summary: Adds and removes cluster nodes based on pending pods.
items.tip: Works on node groups, where Karpenter provisions individual right-sized nodes — a real design difference.

localizedSummary.en: Adds and removes cluster nodes based on pending pods.
localizedSummary.ru: Добавляет и удаляет узлы кластера в зависимости от ожидающих подов.

localizedTip.en: Works on node groups, where Karpenter provisions individual right-sized nodes — a real design difference.

items.name: Consul
items.summary: Service discovery, health checking and service mesh from HashiCorp.
items.tip: Its DNS interface means existing applications discover services without any code change.

localizedSummary.en: Service discovery, health checking and service mesh from HashiCorp.
localizedSummary.ru: Обнаружение сервисов, проверки состояния и service mesh от HashiCorp.

localizedTip.en: Its DNS interface means existing applications discover services without any code change.

items.name: CoreDNS
items.summary: Plugin-based DNS server, the default resolver inside Kubernetes.
items.tip: Its plugin chain lets you add caching or rewriting without a separate DNS layer.

localizedSummary.en: Plugin-based DNS server, the default resolver inside Kubernetes.
localizedSummary.ru: DNS-сервер на плагинах, стандартный резолвер внутри Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Its plugin chain lets you add caching or rewriting without a separate DNS layer.

items.name: CRI-O
items.summary: Lightweight container runtime built specifically for Kubernetes.
items.tip: Implements only what Kubernetes needs, which is a smaller surface than containerd.

localizedSummary.en: Lightweight container runtime built specifically for Kubernetes.
localizedSummary.ru: Лёгкий рантайм контейнеров, созданный специально для Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Implements only what Kubernetes needs, which is a smaller surface than containerd.

items.name: DevSpace
items.summary: Developer tooling for building and debugging applications directly inside a cluster.
items.tip: Running the dev loop in-cluster removes the 'works locally, breaks in Kubernetes' class of bug.

localizedSummary.en: Developer tooling for building and debugging applications directly inside a cluster.
localizedSummary.ru: Инструменты разработчика для сборки и отладки приложений прямо внутри кластера.

localizedTip.en: Running the dev loop in-cluster removes the 'works locally, breaks in Kubernetes' class of bug.

items.name: Envoy
items.summary: L7 proxy and communication bus, the data plane inside most service meshes.
items.tip: You usually configure it through Istio or another control plane rather than writing its config directly.

localizedSummary.en: L7 proxy and communication bus, the data plane inside most service meshes.
localizedSummary.ru: L7-прокси и коммуникационная шина, data plane внутри большинства service mesh.

localizedTip.en: You usually configure it through Istio or another control plane rather than writing its config directly.

items.name: etcd
items.summary: Distributed key-value store providing strong consistency via Raft.
items.tip: Kubernetes stores all its state here, which makes etcd backups your cluster backups.

localizedSummary.en: Distributed key-value store providing strong consistency via Raft.
localizedSummary.ru: Распределённое хранилище ключ-значение со строгой согласованностью через Raft.

localizedTip.en: Kubernetes stores all its state here, which makes etcd backups your cluster backups.

items.name: Flux
items.summary: GitOps continuous delivery for Kubernetes, the CNCF alternative to Argo CD.
items.tip: More composable and controller-driven than Argo CD; Argo has the stronger UI if that matters to your team.

localizedSummary.en: GitOps continuous delivery for Kubernetes, the CNCF alternative to Argo CD.
localizedSummary.ru: GitOps непрерывная доставка для Kubernetes, альтернатива Argo CD в CNCF.

localizedTip.en: More composable and controller-driven than Argo CD; Argo has the stronger UI if that matters to your team.

items.name: Garden
items.summary: Builds, tests and deploys multi-service stacks with aggressive result caching.
items.tip: Caching test results per service means a monorepo CI run only redoes what actually changed.

localizedSummary.en: Builds, tests and deploys multi-service stacks with aggressive result caching.
localizedSummary.ru: Собирает, тестирует и развёртывает многосервисные стеки с агрессивным кэшированием результатов.

localizedTip.en: Caching test results per service means a monorepo CI run only redoes what actually changed.

items.name: Headlamp
items.summary: Extensible open-source Kubernetes UI, usable in-cluster or as a desktop app.
items.tip: Its plugin system lets you surface your own CRDs as first-class UI, which generic dashboards cannot.

localizedSummary.en: Extensible open-source Kubernetes UI, usable in-cluster or as a desktop app.
localizedSummary.ru: Расширяемый открытый интерфейс Kubernetes, работает в кластере или как desktop-приложение.

localizedTip.en: Its plugin system lets you surface your own CRDs as first-class UI, which generic dashboards cannot.

items.name: Helmfile
items.summary: Declarative spec for deploying and templating many Helm releases together.
items.tip: One file describes a whole environment, which plain helm install scripts never manage cleanly.

localizedSummary.en: Declarative spec for deploying and templating many Helm releases together.
localizedSummary.ru: Декларативная спецификация для совместного развёртывания и шаблонизации множества Helm-релизов.

localizedTip.en: One file describes a whole environment, which plain helm install scripts never manage cleanly.

items.name: k0s
items.summary: Kubernetes distribution shipped as a single binary with no OS dependencies.
items.tip: One binary and no host dependencies makes it unusually easy to run on unusual hardware.

localizedSummary.en: Kubernetes distribution shipped as a single binary with no OS dependencies.
localizedSummary.ru: Дистрибутив Kubernetes в виде одного бинарника без зависимостей от ОС.

localizedTip.en: One binary and no host dependencies makes it unusually easy to run on unusual hardware.

items.name: k3d
items.summary: Runs k3s clusters inside Docker for fast local Kubernetes.
items.tip: Multi-node local clusters start in seconds, which suits testing scheduling behaviour.

localizedSummary.en: Runs k3s clusters inside Docker for fast local Kubernetes.
localizedSummary.ru: Запускает кластеры k3s внутри Docker для быстрого локального Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Multi-node local clusters start in seconds, which suits testing scheduling behaviour.

items.name: K3s
items.summary: Lightweight certified Kubernetes distribution in a single binary, good for edge and small servers.
items.tip: Runs comfortably on a Raspberry Pi, unlike full Kubernetes — the whole point of the distribution.

localizedSummary.en: Lightweight certified Kubernetes distribution in a single binary, good for edge and small servers.
localizedSummary.ru: Лёгкий сертифицированный дистрибутив Kubernetes в одном бинарнике для edge и небольших серверов.

localizedTip.en: Runs comfortably on a Raspberry Pi, unlike full Kubernetes — the whole point of the distribution.

items.name: k9s
items.summary: Terminal UI for navigating and managing Kubernetes clusters interactively.
items.tip: Far faster than repeated kubectl commands for exploring what is actually running in a cluster.

localizedSummary.en: Terminal UI for navigating and managing Kubernetes clusters interactively.
localizedSummary.ru: Терминальный интерфейс для интерактивной навигации и управления кластерами Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Far faster than repeated kubectl commands for exploring what is actually running in a cluster.

items.name: KEDA
items.summary: Event-driven autoscaling that scales workloads on queue depth and other external metrics.
items.tip: Scaling on queue depth rather than CPU is what makes worker autoscaling actually responsive.

localizedSummary.en: Event-driven autoscaling that scales workloads on queue depth and other external metrics.
localizedSummary.ru: Событийное автомасштабирование по глубине очереди и другим внешним метрикам.

localizedTip.en: Scaling on queue depth rather than CPU is what makes worker autoscaling actually responsive.

items.name: kind
items.summary: Runs local Kubernetes clusters inside Docker containers, built for testing.
items.tip: Its speed of cluster creation and teardown is what makes it the standard for CI-based k8s testing.

localizedSummary.en: Runs local Kubernetes clusters inside Docker containers, built for testing.
localizedSummary.ru: Запускает локальные кластеры Kubernetes внутри Docker-контейнеров, создан для тестирования.

localizedTip.en: Its speed of cluster creation and teardown is what makes it the standard for CI-based k8s testing.

items.name: kubectx / kubens
items.summary: Fast switching between Kubernetes contexts and namespaces.
items.tip: Pair with a shell prompt showing the current context — most production incidents start with the wrong context.

localizedSummary.en: Fast switching between Kubernetes contexts and namespaces.
localizedSummary.ru: Быстрое переключение между контекстами и пространствами имён Kubernetes.

localizedTip.en: Pair with a shell prompt showing the current context — most production incidents start with the wrong context.

items.name: Kuma
items.summary: Envoy-based service mesh working on both Kubernetes and plain virtual machines.

items.tip: Simpler than Presidio and correspondingly less thorough — verify recall on your own data.

localizedSummary.en: Removes personally identifiable information from free text.
localizedSummary.ru: Удаляет персональные данные из свободного текста.

localizedTip.en: Simpler than Presidio and correspondingly less thorough — verify recall on your own data.

items.name: Semgrep
items.summary: Static analysis with readable, code-pattern-based rules for finding security bugs.
items.tip: Rules look like the code they match, so writing a custom rule for your codebase takes minutes, not hours.

localizedSummary.en: Static analysis with readable, code-pattern-based rules for finding security bugs.
localizedSummary.ru: Статический анализ с читаемыми правилами на основе паттернов кода для поиска уязвимостей.

localizedTip.en: Rules look like the code they match, so writing a custom rule for your codebase takes minutes, not hours.

items.name: Sigstore
items.summary: Keyless artifact signing backed by a public transparency log.
items.tip: Keyless signing removes long-lived private keys entirely, which is where most signing schemes fail in practice.

localizedSummary.en: Keyless artifact signing backed by a public transparency log.
localizedSummary.ru: Подписание артефактов без ключей с публичным журналом прозрачности.

localizedTip.en: Keyless signing removes long-lived private keys entirely, which is where most signing schemes fail in practice.

items.name: SLSA
items.summary: Graded framework of supply chain security levels, from source to build provenance.
items.tip: Start at level 1 (provenance exists) — the higher levels require build-platform changes, not just policy.

localizedSummary.en: Graded framework of supply chain security levels, from source to build provenance.
localizedSummary.ru: Градуированный фреймворк уровней безопасности цепочки поставок — от исходников до провенанса сборки.

localizedTip.en: Start at level 1 (provenance exists) — the higher levels require build-platform changes, not just policy.

items.name: StackHawk
items.summary: Developer-focused dynamic security testing built to run in CI.
items.tip: Scanning against a running test environment in the pipeline catches issues pre-merge.

localizedSummary.en: Developer-focused dynamic security testing built to run in CI.
localizedSummary.ru: Динамическое тестирование безопасности для разработчиков, рассчитанное на запуск в CI.

localizedTip.en: Scanning against a running test environment in the pipeline catches issues pre-merge.

items.name: step-ca
items.summary: Private certificate authority with ACME support for internal services.
items.tip: It brings automated certificates to internal names that public CAs cannot issue for.

localizedSummary.en: Private certificate authority with ACME support for internal services.
localizedSummary.ru: Приватный удостоверяющий центр с поддержкой ACME для внутренних сервисов.

localizedTip.en: It brings automated certificates to internal names that public CAs cannot issue for.

items.name: Suricata
items.summary: High-performance network IDS/IPS with deep packet inspection and protocol parsing.
items.tip: Multi-threaded, unlike Snort's classic engine, which is why it keeps up on high-bandwidth links.

localizedSummary.en: High-performance network IDS/IPS with deep packet inspection and protocol parsing.
localizedSummary.ru: Высокопроизводительная сетевая IDS/IPS с глубоким анализом пакетов и разбором протоколов.

localizedTip.en: Multi-threaded, unlike Snort's classic engine, which is why it keeps up on high-bandwidth links.

items.name: Syft
items.summary: Generates a software bill of materials from container images and source trees.
items.tip: An SBOM committed with each release is what makes 'are we affected by this CVE' answerable in minutes.

localizedSummary.en: Generates a software bill of materials from container images and source trees.
localizedSummary.ru: Генерирует software bill of materials из образов контейнеров и исходных деревьев.

localizedTip.en: An SBOM committed with each release is what makes 'are we affected by this CVE' answerable in minutes.

items.name: Tailscale
items.summary: Zero-configuration mesh VPN built on WireGuard.
items.tip: It traverses network address translation automatically, which is what makes it feel effortless.

localizedSummary.en: Zero-configuration mesh VPN built on WireGuard.
localizedSummary.ru: Mesh-VPN без настройки на базе WireGuard.

localizedTip.en: It traverses network address translation automatically, which is what makes it feel effortless.

items.name: Teleport
items.summary: Access platform for SSH, Kubernetes, databases and web apps with session recording.
items.tip: Session recording and audit logs are what make production access reviewable after the fact.

localizedSummary.en: Access platform for SSH, Kubernetes, databases and web apps with session recording.
localizedSummary.ru: Платформа доступа к SSH, Kubernetes, базам данных и веб-приложениям с записью сессий.

localizedTip.en: Session recording and audit logs are what make production access reviewable after the fact.

items.name: tfsec
items.summary: Terraform-focused security scanner, now merged into the Trivy project.
items.tip: New work goes into Trivy's IaC mode — prefer that for greenfield rather than the standalone binary.

localizedSummary.en: Terraform-focused security scanner, now merged into the Trivy project.
localizedSummary.ru: Сканер безопасности, ориентированный на Terraform, теперь объединён с проектом Trivy.

localizedTip.en: New work goes into Trivy's IaC mode — prefer that for greenfield rather than the standalone binary.

items.name: Traceable
items.summary: API security built on distributed tracing for full request context.
items.tip: Tracing across services shows the full path of an attack, not just the entry point.

localizedSummary.en: API security built on distributed tracing for full request context.
localizedSummary.ru: Безопасность API на основе распределённой трассировки с полным контекстом запроса.

localizedTip.en: Tracing across services shows the full path of an attack, not just the entry point.

items.name: Trivy
items.summary: Scans containers, filesystems and IaC for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
items.tip: Add it as a CI step on your Dockerfile build — it catches vulnerable base images before they ship.

localizedSummary.en: Scans containers, filesystems and IaC for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
localizedSummary.ru: Сканирует контейнеры, файловые системы и IaC на уязвимости и ошибки конфигурации.

localizedTip.en: Add it as a CI step on your Dockerfile build — it catches vulnerable base images before they ship.

items.name: TruffleHog
items.summary: Scans repositories and history for leaked credentials, then verifies whether they still work.
items.tip: Live verification is the differentiator — it separates real active leaks from expired noise.

localizedSummary.en: Scans repositories and history for leaked credentials, then verifies whether they still work.
localizedSummary.ru: Сканирует репозитории и историю на утёкшие учётные данные и проверяет, работают ли они ещё.

localizedTip.en: Live verification is the differentiator — it separates real active leaks from expired noise.

items.name: Unbound
items.summary: Validating recursive DNS resolver with DNSSEC support.
items.tip: Running your own recursive resolver means no upstream provider sees your query history.

localizedSummary.en: Validating recursive DNS resolver with DNSSEC support.
localizedSummary.ru: Проверяющий рекурсивный DNS-резолвер с поддержкой DNSSEC.

localizedTip.en: Running your own recursive resolver means no upstream provider sees your query history.

items.name: Wazuh
items.summary: Open-source SIEM and XDR platform with agents for endpoint detection and compliance.
items.tip: A full SIEM without licence cost, at the price of running and tuning the whole stack yourself.

localizedSummary.en: Open-source SIEM and XDR platform with agents for endpoint detection and compliance.
localizedSummary.ru: Открытая платформа SIEM и XDR с агентами для обнаружения на конечных точках и комплаенса.

localizedTip.en: A full SIEM without licence cost, at the price of running and tuning the whole stack yourself.

items.name: WireGuard
items.summary: Modern VPN protocol with a very small, auditable codebase.
items.tip: A few thousand lines of code, against OpenVPN's hundreds of thousands — that is the security argument.

localizedSummary.en: Modern VPN protocol with a very small, auditable codebase.
localizedSummary.ru: Современный VPN-протокол с очень небольшой проверяемой кодовой базой.

localizedTip.en: A few thousand lines of code, against OpenVPN's hundreds of thousands — that is the security argument.

items.name: Wiz
items.summary: Agentless cloud security platform scanning workloads and mapping attack paths.
items.tip: Attack-path analysis prioritizes the handful of findings that actually chain into a breach.

localizedSummary.en: Agentless cloud security platform scanning workloads and mapping attack paths.
localizedSummary.ru: Безагентная платформа облачной безопасности: сканирует нагрузки и строит пути атак.

localizedTip.en: Attack-path analysis prioritizes the handful of findings that actually chain into a breach.

items.name: Zeek
items.summary: Network analysis framework producing rich connection logs rather than firing alerts.
items.tip: Its logs are the forensic record — you use them after an incident, where an IDS alert tells you nothing.

localizedSummary.en: Network analysis framework producing rich connection logs rather than firing alerts.
localizedSummary.ru: Фреймворк сетевого анализа, выдающий подробные логи соединений, а не срабатывающие оповещения.

localizedTip.en: Its logs are the forensic record — you use them after an incident, where an IDS alert tells you nothing.

items.name: ZeroTier
items.summary: Virtual network creating a layer 2 network across the internet.
items.tip: Layer 2 emulation carries broadcast protocols that layer 3 overlays like WireGuard drop.

localizedSummary.en: Virtual network creating a layer 2 network across the internet.
localizedSummary.ru: Виртуальная сеть, создающая сеть второго уровня поверх интернета.

localizedTip.en: Layer 2 emulation carries broadcast protocols that layer 3 overlays like WireGuard drop.

items.name: Puppeteer
items.summary: Headless Chrome control for screenshots, PDFs and scraping.
items.tip: Screenshot and PDF generation is the quickest win: it renders your real CSS.

localizedSummary.en: Headless Chrome control for screenshots, PDFs and scraping.
localizedSummary.ru: Управление headless Chrome для скриншотов, PDF и скрапинга.

localizedTip.en: Screenshot and PDF generation is the quickest win: it renders your real CSS.

items.name: Scrapy
items.summary: Mature crawling framework with pipelines, throttling and retries.
items.tip: Respect robots.txt and set a download delay: politeness keeps your IP usable.

localizedSummary.en: Mature crawling framework with pipelines, throttling and retries.
localizedSummary.ru: Зрелый фреймворк краулинга с пайплайнами, троттлингом и ретраями.

localizedTip.en: Respect robots.txt and set a download delay: politeness keeps your IP usable.

items.name: Loki

items.tip: Docker-based rendering keeps screenshots pixel-identical across every machine that runs the suite.

localizedSummary.en: Free, self-hosted visual regression testing for Storybook using Docker-based browsers.

localizedTip.en: Docker-based rendering keeps screenshots pixel-identical across every machine that runs the suite.

items.name: Playwright Visual Comparisons

localizedSummary.en: Built-in screenshot comparison in Playwright — no separate visual-testing service required.

items.name: Antora
items.summary: Documentation site generator assembling content from many repositories.
items.tip: Multi-repository aggregation is its distinguishing feature, which suits large product suites.

localizedSummary.en: Documentation site generator assembling content from many repositories.
localizedSummary.ru: Генератор сайтов документации, собирающий контент из множества репозиториев.

localizedTip.en: Multi-repository aggregation is its distinguishing feature, which suits large product suites.

items.name: asciinema
items.summary: Records terminal sessions as text rather than video.
items.tip: Viewers can select and copy the commands, which a screen recording never allows.

localizedTip.en: Viewers can select and copy the commands, which a screen recording never allows.

items.name: D2
items.summary: Modern declarative diagram language with automatic layout.
items.tip: Its layout engines produce noticeably cleaner results than Mermaid on dense diagrams.

localizedSummary.en: Modern declarative diagram language with automatic layout.
localizedSummary.ru: Современный декларативный язык диаграмм с автоматической раскладкой.

localizedTip.en: Its layout engines produce noticeably cleaner results than Mermaid on dense diagrams.

items.name: Docsify
items.summary: Renders Markdown documentation at runtime with no build step.

localizedSummary.ru: Отрисовывает документацию Markdown во время выполнения, без этапа сборки.

items.name: Docusaurus

localizedSummary.en: Documentation site framework with versioning, i18n and search.
localizedSummary.ru: Фреймворк для документации с версионированием, i18n и поиском.

localizedTip.en: Versioned docs are the feature you will miss most if you roll your own.

items.name: GitBook
items.summary: Documentation platform with a visual editor and Git synchronization.
items.tip: Non-engineers edit in the browser while the content still lands in your repository.

localizedSummary.en: Documentation platform with a visual editor and Git synchronization.
localizedSummary.ru: Платформа документации с визуальным редактором и синхронизацией через Git.

localizedTip.en: Non-engineers edit in the browser while the content still lands in your repository.

items.name: Graphviz
items.summary: The foundational graph layout toolkit, driven by the DOT language.

localizedSummary.en: The foundational graph layout toolkit, driven by the DOT language.
localizedSummary.ru: Фундаментальный набор инструментов раскладки графов на языке DOT.

items.name: Jekyll
items.summary: Ruby static site generator with native GitHub Pages support.

localizedSummary.ru: Генератор статических сайтов на Ruby с нативной поддержкой GitHub Pages.

items.name: Marp
items.summary: Markdown presentation ecosystem with PDF and HTML export.

items.summary: The open-source engine that powers most automated accessibility testing tools.

items.name: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y
items.summary: Lint rules catching common accessibility mistakes directly in JSX as you write it.
items.tip: Catches missing alt text and invalid ARIA roles before code review, not after a scan.

localizedTip.en: Catches missing alt text and invalid ARIA roles before code review, not after a scan.

items.name: focus-trap
items.summary: Traps keyboard focus inside a modal or dialog, a core accessibility requirement.
items.tip: Every custom modal needs this — without it, keyboard users tab straight out into the page behind.

localizedSummary.en: Traps keyboard focus inside a modal or dialog, a core accessibility requirement.

localizedTip.en: Every custom modal needs this — without it, keyboard users tab straight out into the page behind.

items.name: Pa11y
items.summary: Command-line accessibility testing that fits naturally into a CI pipeline.
items.tip: pa11y-ci runs a whole sitemap of URLs in one CI step — set it up once and forget about it.

localizedSummary.en: Command-line accessibility testing that fits naturally into a CI pipeline.
localizedSummary.ru: Тестирование доступности из командной строки, естественно вписывается в CI-пайплайн.

localizedTip.en: pa11y-ci runs a whole sitemap of URLs in one CI step — set it up once and forget about it.

items.name: React Aria
items.summary: Adobe's accessible interaction hooks: full keyboard, screen-reader and focus behavior, unstyled.
items.tip: The accessibility behavior here is more thoroughly tested than most teams could build in-house.

localizedTip.en: The accessibility behavior here is more thoroughly tested than most teams could build in-house.

items.name: Ansible
items.summary: Agentless configuration management over SSH with idempotent playbooks.

localizedTip.en: Idempotence is a property of the modules you use, not a guarantee: avoid raw shell tasks.

items.name: CFEngine
items.summary: The original configuration management system, with a very small agent footprint.

localizedTip.en: Its tiny agent still suits embedded and heavily constrained systems others cannot reach.

items.name: Chef
items.summary: Ruby-based configuration management with reusable cookbooks.

localizedSummary.en: Ruby-based configuration management with reusable cookbooks.

localizedTip.en: Its compliance scanning is often the reason it persists in regulated enterprises.

items.name: Crossplane

items.name: OpenTofu

localizedTip.en: Baking dependencies into the image cuts boot time versus configuring instances after launch.

items.name: Pulumi
items.summary: Infrastructure as code in general-purpose languages with real types and loops.
items.tip: Loops and functions beat HCL copy-paste, but the same discipline about state still applies.

items.name: Puppet
items.summary: Declarative configuration management with an agent-based pull model.

localizedTip.en: Agents continuously reconcile drift, unlike push tools that only apply when you run them.

items.name: Salt
items.summary: Configuration management and remote execution built for very large fleets.

localizedSummary.en: Configuration management and remote execution built for very large fleets.
localizedSummary.ru: Управление конфигурацией и удалённое выполнение для очень больших парков машин.

localizedTip.en: Its event-driven message bus executes across thousands of nodes far faster than SSH-based tools.

items.name: Babel (Python)

items.name: FormatJS
items.summary: ICU message formatting built on the platform Intl APIs.

localizedTip.en: ICU syntax handles gender and plural rules that string concatenation gets wrong.

items.name: i18next

items.name: Temporal API polyfill

localizedTip.en: Worth adopting now for new code — it becomes the platform standard and removes the need for a date library.

items.name: direnv
