items.tip: Assert nock's interceptors were actually called — an unused mock silently means your code took a different path.

localizedSummary.en: HTTP mocking for Node.js tests, intercepting outgoing requests at the network layer.
localizedSummary.ru: Мокинг HTTP для тестов Node.js, перехватывает исходящие запросы на сетевом уровне.

localizedTip.en: Assert nock's interceptors were actually called — an unused mock silently means your code took a different path.

items.name: Node Test Runner
items.summary: Test runner built into Node, requiring no external dependency.
items.tip: Enough for a library with modest needs, and it removes a whole dependency tree from CI.

localizedSummary.en: Test runner built into Node, requiring no external dependency.
localizedSummary.ru: Раннер тестов, встроенный в Node и не требующий внешних зависимостей.

localizedTip.en: Enough for a library with modest needs, and it removes a whole dependency tree from CI.

items.name: nox
items.summary: Test automation where environments are configured in ordinary Python.
items.tip: Python configuration handles conditional logic that tox's INI format cannot express.

localizedSummary.en: Test automation where environments are configured in ordinary Python.
localizedSummary.ru: Автоматизация тестирования, где окружения настраиваются на обычном Python.

localizedTip.en: Python configuration handles conditional logic that tox's INI format cannot express.

items.name: oxlint
items.summary: Very fast JavaScript and TypeScript linter for large repositories.
items.tip: Fast enough to run on every save in a monorepo where ESLint takes minutes.

localizedSummary.en: Very fast JavaScript and TypeScript linter for large repositories.
localizedSummary.ru: Очень быстрый линтер JavaScript и TypeScript для больших репозиториев.

localizedTip.en: Fast enough to run on every save in a monorepo where ESLint takes minutes.

items.name: Pact
items.summary: Consumer-driven contract testing between services.
items.tip: Catches breaking API changes in CI without standing up every service in an integration environment.

localizedSummary.en: Consumer-driven contract testing between services.
localizedSummary.ru: Контрактное тестирование между сервисами, управляемое потребителем.

localizedTip.en: Catches breaking API changes in CI without standing up every service in an integration environment.

items.name: Playwright
items.summary: Надёжная автоматизация Chromium, Firefox и WebKit для E2E и browser tasks.
items.tip: Ищи элементы по роли и имени, а не по хрупким CSS-селекторам.

showcases.title: Trace Viewer demo
showcases.note: Open a real test trace in the browser

localizedNote.en: Open a real test trace in the browser
localizedNote.ru: Открывает реальный trace теста в браузере

items.name: Playwright Test Fixtures
items.summary: Playwright's fixture system for sharing setup and teardown across tests.
items.tip: Worker-scoped fixtures let expensive setup (like login) run once per worker rather than per test.

localizedSummary.en: Playwright's fixture system for sharing setup and teardown across tests.
localizedSummary.ru: Система фикстур Playwright для общей подготовки и очистки между тестами.

localizedTip.en: Worker-scoped fixtures let expensive setup (like login) run once per worker rather than per test.

items.name: Polly.JS
items.summary: Records and replays HTTP interactions for deterministic tests.
items.tip: Recorded fixtures keep tests fast and offline while still matching the real API's responses.

localizedSummary.en: Records and replays HTTP interactions for deterministic tests.
localizedSummary.ru: Записывает и воспроизводит HTTP-взаимодействия для детерминированных тестов.

localizedTip.en: Recorded fixtures keep tests fast and offline while still matching the real API's responses.

items.name: pre-commit
items.summary: Pins and runs git hooks identically on every machine and in CI.
items.tip: Run the same config in CI too, otherwise the hooks become optional in practice.

localizedSummary.en: Pins and runs git hooks identically on every machine and in CI.
localizedSummary.ru: Фиксирует и запускает git-хуки одинаково на всех машинах и в CI.

localizedTip.en: Run the same config in CI too, otherwise the hooks become optional in practice.

items.name: Prettier
items.summary: Opinionated formatter для JS, TS, CSS, JSON, Markdown и других форматов.
items.tip: Пусть Prettier форматирует, а ESLint ищет ошибки — не дублируй стилистические правила.

items.name: promptfoo
items.summary: Declarative prompt and model comparison with assertions, runnable in CI.
items.tip: Version the config beside your prompts so a regression shows up as a failing check.

localizedSummary.en: Declarative prompt and model comparison with assertions, runnable in CI.
localizedSummary.ru: Декларативное сравнение промптов и моделей с проверками, запускается в CI.

localizedTip.en: Version the config beside your prompts so a regression shows up as a failing check.

items.name: PropEr
items.summary: Property-based testing for Erlang and Elixir, including stateful models.
items.tip: Its state machine testing explores interleavings that hand-written concurrency tests never reach.

localizedSummary.en: Property-based testing for Erlang and Elixir, including stateful models.
localizedSummary.ru: Property-based тестирование для Erlang и Elixir, включая модели с состоянием.

localizedTip.en: Its state machine testing explores interleavings that hand-written concurrency tests never reach.

items.name: Pylint
items.summary: Thorough Python linter checking style, errors and code smells.
items.tip: Its design checks (too many arguments, too many branches) catch complexity other linters ignore.

localizedSummary.en: Thorough Python linter checking style, errors and code smells.
localizedSummary.ru: Тщательный линтер Python, проверяющий стиль, ошибки и запахи кода.

localizedTip.en: Its design checks (too many arguments, too many branches) catch complexity other linters ignore.

items.name: Pyright
items.summary: Fast Python type checker from Microsoft, the engine behind Pylance.
items.tip: Considerably faster than mypy and stricter by default, which surfaces more genuine errors.

localizedSummary.en: Fast Python type checker from Microsoft, the engine behind Pylance.
localizedSummary.ru: Быстрый проверщик типов Python от Microsoft, движок Pylance.

localizedTip.en: Considerably faster than mypy and stricter by default, which surfaces more genuine errors.

items.name: pytest
items.summary: Мощный Python test framework с fixtures, parametrization и plugins.
items.tip: Fixtures держи маленькими и явными; autouse легко создаёт скрытые зависимости.

items.name: QuickCheck
items.summary: The original property-based testing library, from Haskell.
items.tip: Every property testing tool in other languages traces its design back to this one.

localizedSummary.en: The original property-based testing library, from Haskell.
localizedSummary.ru: Оригинальная библиотека property-based тестирования из Haskell.

localizedTip.en: Every property testing tool in other languages traces its design back to this one.

items.name: RSpec
items.summary: Behaviour-driven testing framework, the Ruby community's testing standard.
items.tip: Its readable spec syntax doubles as documentation of intended behaviour.

localizedSummary.en: Behaviour-driven testing framework, the Ruby community's testing standard.
localizedSummary.ru: Фреймворк BDD-тестирования, стандарт тестирования в Ruby-сообществе.

localizedTip.en: Its readable spec syntax doubles as documentation of intended behaviour.

items.name: Ruff
items.summary: Очень быстрый Python linter и formatter на Rust.
items.tip: Начни с базового набора правил и расширяй постепенно, чтобы не получить сотни бессмысленных правок.

items.name: Schemathesis
items.summary: Property-based API testing generated directly from an OpenAPI or GraphQL schema.
items.tip: Point it at your OpenAPI spec and it finds edge cases no one thought to write a manual test for.

localizedSummary.en: Property-based API testing generated directly from an OpenAPI or GraphQL schema.
localizedSummary.ru: Property-based тестирование API, генерируемое прямо из схемы OpenAPI или GraphQL.

localizedTip.en: Point it at your OpenAPI spec and it finds edge cases no one thought to write a manual test for.

items.name: Selenium
items.summary: The original browser automation standard, with bindings in every major language.
items.tip: WebDriver is a W3C standard, which is why it survives where vendor-specific tools do not.

localizedSummary.en: The original browser automation standard, with bindings in every major language.
localizedSummary.ru: Оригинальный стандарт автоматизации браузера с биндингами на всех основных языках.

localizedTip.en: WebDriver is a W3C standard, which is why it survives where vendor-specific tools do not.

items.name: Sinon.JS
items.summary: Standalone spies, stubs, mocks and fake timers for JavaScript tests.
items.tip: Its fake timers make time-dependent code testable without any real waiting.

localizedSummary.en: Standalone spies, stubs, mocks and fake timers for JavaScript tests.
localizedSummary.ru: Автономные шпионы, заглушки, моки и фиктивные таймеры для JavaScript-тестов.

localizedTip.en: Its fake timers make time-dependent code testable without any real waiting.

items.name: Sourcery
items.summary: Suggests and applies Python refactorings as you write code.
items.tip: Free for open-source projects, and its suggestions double as a way to learn idiomatic Python.

localizedSummary.en: Suggests and applies Python refactorings as you write code.
localizedSummary.ru: Предлагает и применяет рефакторинги Python прямо во время написания кода.

localizedTip.en: Free for open-source projects, and its suggestions double as a way to learn idiomatic Python.

items.name: Storybook
items.summary: Изолированная разработка, документация и visual testing UI-компонентов.
items.tip: Сделай stories для loading, empty, error и длинного текста — именно там ломается UI.

items.name: Storybook Test
items.summary: Runs component interaction tests directly against Storybook stories.
items.tip: Stories double as test fixtures, so you maintain one set of component states rather than two.

localizedSummary.en: Runs component interaction tests directly against Storybook stories.
localizedSummary.ru: Запускает тесты взаимодействия компонентов прямо на Storybook-историях.

localizedTip.en: Stories double as test fixtures, so you maintain one set of component states rather than two.

items.name: StrykerJS
items.summary: Mutation testing for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
items.tip: Run it occasionally on critical modules, not on every CI run — mutation testing is inherently slow.

localizedSummary.en: Mutation testing for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
localizedSummary.ru: Мутационное тестирование для проектов JavaScript и TypeScript.

localizedTip.en: Run it occasionally on critical modules, not on every CI run — mutation testing is inherently slow.

items.name: Stylelint
items.summary: Linter for CSS and CSS-like syntaxes, enforcing conventions and catching errors.
items.tip: The standard config catches genuine mistakes; add ordering rules only if your team actually wants them.

localizedSummary.en: Linter for CSS and CSS-like syntaxes, enforcing conventions and catching errors.
localizedSummary.ru: Линтер CSS и CSS-подобных синтаксисов, обеспечивает соблюдение конвенций и ловит ошибки.

localizedTip.en: The standard config catches genuine mistakes; add ordering rules only if your team actually wants them.

items.name: TestCafe
items.summary: End-to-end testing that needs no WebDriver and waits for elements automatically.
items.tip: Its proxy-based approach means no browser driver to install or keep in version sync.

localizedSummary.en: End-to-end testing that needs no WebDriver and waits for elements automatically.
localizedSummary.ru: E2E-тестирование без WebDriver с автоматическим ожиданием элементов.

localizedTip.en: Its proxy-based approach means no browser driver to install or keep in version sync.

items.name: Testcontainers
items.summary: Real Postgres, Redis or Kafka in tests, started and torn down automatically.
items.tip: Removes the mock-versus-reality gap in data-access code, at the cost of slower tests.

localizedSummary.en: Real Postgres, Redis or Kafka in tests, started and torn down automatically.
localizedSummary.ru: Настоящие Postgres, Redis или Kafka в тестах, поднимаются и гасятся автоматически.

localizedTip.en: Removes the mock-versus-reality gap in data-access code, at the cost of slower tests.

items.name: Testing Library
items.summary: Test utilities that query the DOM the way a user would.
items.tip: Querying by role and label improves accessibility as a side effect of writing tests.

localizedSummary.en: Test utilities that query the DOM the way a user would.
localizedSummary.ru: Тестовые утилиты, которые ищут элементы так же, как это делает пользователь.

localizedTip.en: Querying by role and label improves accessibility as a side effect of writing tests.

items.name: tox
items.summary: Runs Python test suites across multiple interpreter versions and environments.
items.tip: Catches version-specific breakage locally, before a CI matrix finds it for you.

localizedSummary.en: Runs Python test suites across multiple interpreter versions and environments.
localizedSummary.ru: Запускает наборы тестов Python на нескольких версиях интерпретатора и в разных окружениях.

localizedTip.en: Catches version-specific breakage locally, before a CI matrix finds it for you.

items.name: ty
items.summary: Extremely fast Python type checker in Rust, from the Ruff team.
items.tip: Still pre-release — worth tracking, but keep mypy or Pyright as the checker CI depends on.

localizedSummary.en: Extremely fast Python type checker in Rust, from the Ruff team.
localizedSummary.ru: Крайне быстрый проверщик типов Python на Rust от команды Ruff.

localizedTip.en: Still pre-release — worth tracking, but keep mypy or Pyright as the checker CI depends on.

items.name: unittest
items.summary: Python's built-in xUnit-style testing framework.
items.tip: pytest runs unittest tests unchanged, so migrating is additive rather than a rewrite.

localizedSummary.en: Python's built-in xUnit-style testing framework.
localizedSummary.ru: Встроенный в Python фреймворк тестирования в стиле xUnit.

localizedTip.en: pytest runs unittest tests unchanged, so migrating is additive rather than a rewrite.

items.name: Vegeta
items.summary: HTTP load testing tool that sustains a constant request rate.
items.tip: Constant-rate testing reveals latency under a fixed load, which concurrency-based tools obscure.

localizedSummary.en: HTTP load testing tool that sustains a constant request rate.
localizedSummary.ru: Инструмент HTTP-нагрузки, удерживающий постоянную частоту запросов.

localizedTip.en: Constant-rate testing reveals latency under a fixed load, which concurrency-based tools obscure.

items.name: Vitest
items.summary: Быстрый Vite-native unit test framework, совместимый с Jest API.
items.tip: Не тестируй детали реализации компонентов — проверяй наблюдаемое поведение.

items.name: Vitest UI
items.summary: Browser-based test result UI for Vitest, with live re-runs and coverage view.
items.tip: Leave it running in a second monitor during TDD — failures highlight instantly without switching windows.

localizedSummary.en: Browser-based test result UI for Vitest, with live re-runs and coverage view.
localizedSummary.ru: Браузерный интерфейс результатов тестов для Vitest с живым перезапуском и просмотром покрытия.

localizedTip.en: Leave it running in a second monitor during TDD — failures highlight instantly without switching windows.

items.name: Web Test Runner
items.summary: Runs tests in real browsers using native ES modules, framework-agnostic.
items.tip: Good default for testing plain web components without pulling in a full framework's test setup.

localizedSummary.en: Runs tests in real browsers using native ES modules, framework-agnostic.
localizedSummary.ru: Запускает тесты в реальных браузерах на нативных ES-модулях, независимо от фреймворка.

localizedTip.en: Good default for testing plain web components without pulling in a full framework's test setup.

items.name: WebdriverIO
items.summary: Automation framework covering web and mobile via WebDriver and DevTools.
items.tip: One framework across browsers and native mobile apps, which most competitors do not span.

localizedSummary.en: Automation framework covering web and mobile via WebDriver and DevTools.
localizedSummary.ru: Фреймворк автоматизации для веба и мобильных устройств через WebDriver и DevTools.

localizedTip.en: One framework across browsers and native mobile apps, which most competitors do not span.

items.name: wrk
items.summary: Minimal high-performance HTTP benchmarking tool.
items.tip: Its Lua scripting covers custom request patterns without leaving the single-binary model.

localizedSummary.en: Minimal high-performance HTTP benchmarking tool.
localizedSummary.ru: Минималистичный высокопроизводительный инструмент HTTP-бенчмаркинга.

localizedTip.en: Its Lua scripting covers custom request patterns without leaving the single-binary model.

items.name: Bruno
items.summary: API client storing collections as plain files in your repository.
items.tip: Collections version and merge like code, which cloud-synced clients make awkward.

localizedSummary.en: API client storing collections as plain files in your repository.
localizedSummary.ru: API-клиент, хранящий коллекции обычными файлами в вашем репозитории.

localizedTip.en: Collections version and merge like code, which cloud-synced clients make awkward.

items.name: Hoppscotch
items.summary: Lightweight open-source API client that runs in the browser.
items.tip: Nothing to install, and self-hostable when requests must stay inside your network.

localizedSummary.en: Lightweight open-source API client that runs in the browser.
localizedSummary.ru: Лёгкий открытый API-клиент, работающий в браузере.

localizedTip.en: Nothing to install, and self-hostable when requests must stay inside your network.

items.name: Insomnia
items.summary: API client and design tool supporting REST, GraphQL and gRPC.
items.tip: Its gRPC support is unusual among general API clients and saves reaching for grpcurl.

localizedSummary.en: API client and design tool supporting REST, GraphQL and gRPC.
localizedSummary.ru: API-клиент и инструмент проектирования с поддержкой REST, GraphQL и gRPC.

localizedTip.en: Its gRPC support is unusual among general API clients and saves reaching for grpcurl.

items.name: Postman Flows
items.summary: Visual workflow builder chaining API requests inside Postman.
items.tip: Useful for prototyping a multi-step integration before writing any code for it.

localizedSummary.en: Visual workflow builder chaining API requests inside Postman.
localizedSummary.ru: Визуальный конструктор workflow, связывающий API-запросы внутри Postman.

localizedTip.en: Useful for prototyping a multi-step integration before writing any code for it.

items.name: Prism
items.summary: Mock server generated directly from an OpenAPI description.
items.tip: Frontend work can start against the spec before the backend exists, with no hand-written mocks.

localizedSummary.en: Mock server generated directly from an OpenAPI description.
localizedSummary.ru: Mock-сервер, генерируемый напрямую из OpenAPI-описания.

localizedTip.en: Frontend work can start against the spec before the backend exists, with no hand-written mocks.

items.name: RapidAPI
items.summary: API marketplace with unified authentication and billing across providers.
items.tip: Convenient for discovery, though calling a provider directly is usually cheaper in production.

localizedSummary.en: API marketplace with unified authentication and billing across providers.
localizedSummary.ru: Маркетплейс API с единой аутентификацией и биллингом для разных провайдеров.

localizedTip.en: Convenient for discovery, though calling a provider directly is usually cheaper in production.

items.name: WireMock
items.summary: HTTP mock server for stubbing and verifying service interactions.
items.tip: Its fault and delay injection tests how your client behaves when a dependency misbehaves.

localizedSummary.en: HTTP mock server for stubbing and verifying service interactions.
localizedSummary.ru: HTTP mock-сервер для заглушек и проверки взаимодействий между сервисами.

localizedTip.en: Its fault and delay injection tests how your client behaves when a dependency misbehaves.

items.name: Yaak
items.summary: Desktop API client built in Rust with optional Git synchronization.
items.tip: Fast and offline-first, with none of the account requirements newer clients have added.

localizedSummary.en: Desktop API client built in Rust with optional Git synchronization.
localizedSummary.ru: Desktop API-клиент на Rust с опциональной синхронизацией через Git.

localizedTip.en: Fast and offline-first, with none of the account requirements newer clients have added.

items.name: mise
items.summary: Per-project runtime versions, environment variables and tasks in one config.
items.tip: Replaces nvm, pyenv and rbenv at once, and the versions are committed with the repo.

localizedSummary.en: Per-project runtime versions, environment variables and tasks in one config.
localizedSummary.ru: Версии рантаймов, переменные окружения и задачи проекта в одном конфиге.

localizedTip.en: Replaces nvm, pyenv and rbenv at once, and the versions are committed with the repo.

items.name: Ajv
items.summary: The fastest JSON Schema validator for JavaScript, used across the tooling ecosystem.

localizedSummary.ru: Самый быстрый валидатор JSON Schema для JavaScript, используется во всей экосистеме тулинга.

items.name: ArkType
items.summary: TypeScript validation using type-like syntax with full static inference.
items.tip: Schemas read almost exactly like TypeScript type annotations, which keeps them easy to scan.

localizedSummary.en: TypeScript validation using type-like syntax with full static inference.
localizedSummary.ru: Валидация TypeScript с синтаксисом в духе типов и полным статическим выводом.

localizedTip.en: Schemas read almost exactly like TypeScript type annotations, which keeps them easy to scan.

items.name: attrs
items.summary: Python classes without boilerplate, with validators and converters.

localizedSummary.en: Python classes without boilerplate, with validators and converters.
localizedSummary.ru: Классы Python без шаблонного кода, с валидаторами и конвертерами.

localizedTip.en: It predates and inspired dataclasses, and still offers features the standard library lacks.

items.name: Beautiful Soup
items.summary: The standard Python HTML/XML parsing library, tolerant of malformed markup.

localizedSummary.en: The standard Python HTML/XML parsing library, tolerant of malformed markup.
localizedSummary.ru: Стандартная библиотека парсинга HTML/XML в Python, устойчива к некорректной разметке.

items.name: cattrs
items.summary: Structures and unstructures Python objects to and from plain data.

localizedSummary.en: Structures and unstructures Python objects to and from plain data.
localizedSummary.ru: Преобразует объекты Python в простые данные и обратно.

localizedTip.en: Separating serialization from the class definition keeps model classes free of encoding concerns.

items.name: Cerberus
items.summary: Lightweight dictionary validation for Python with schema definitions as plain dicts.
items.tip: Simpler than Pydantic when you validate loose dicts rather than construct typed model objects.

localizedSummary.en: Lightweight dictionary validation for Python with schema definitions as plain dicts.
localizedSummary.ru: Лёгкая валидация словарей в Python со схемами в виде обычных dict.

localizedTip.en: Simpler than Pydantic when you validate loose dicts rather than construct typed model objects.

items.name: Cheerio
items.summary: Server-side HTML parsing with a jQuery-like API, no browser required.

localizedSummary.en: Server-side HTML parsing with a jQuery-like API, no browser required.
localizedSummary.ru: Парсинг HTML на сервере с API в духе jQuery, без браузера.

localizedTip.en: Far faster than a headless browser for static HTML — only reach for Playwright when JS rendering is required.

items.name: date-fns

localizedSummary.ru: Модульная библиотека для дат с импортом отдельных функций.

items.name: Day.js
items.summary: 2KB date library with a Moment.js-compatible API, the lightweight successor most projects migrate to.

localizedSummary.en: 2KB date library with a Moment.js-compatible API, the lightweight successor most projects migrate to.
localizedSummary.ru: 2КБ библиотека дат с API, совместимым с Moment.js — лёгкий преемник, на который переезжает большинство проектов.

items.name: io-ts

localizedSummary.ru: Рантайм-валидация типов на кодеках fp-ts.

localizedTip.en: Its functional style suits fp-ts codebases; Zod is friendlier for everyone else.

items.name: Joi
items.summary: Powerful server-side object schema validation for Node.

localizedSummary.en: Powerful server-side object schema validation for Node.
localizedSummary.ru: Мощная серверная валидация схем объектов для Node.

localizedTip.en: Its conditional and dependency rules express constraints that simpler validators cannot.

items.name: js-yaml

items.name: Lodash
items.summary: The classic JavaScript utility library: deep clone, debounce, grouping and dozens more.

items.name: x264

items.name: Janus WebRTC Server
items.summary: General-purpose WebRTC server with a plugin architecture.

items.name: mediasoup

items.name: PeerJS
items.summary: Simplifies WebRTC peer connections with a small friendly API.

localizedSummary.en: Simplifies WebRTC peer connections with a small friendly API.

localizedTip.en: You still need a TURN server for users behind restrictive network address translation.

items.name: Pion
items.summary: Pure Go implementation of WebRTC.
items.tip: No cgo dependency means it cross-compiles as easily as any other Go program.

localizedSummary.en: Pure Go implementation of WebRTC.

localizedTip.en: No cgo dependency means it cross-compiles as easily as any other Go program.

items.name: simple-peer
items.summary: Minimal WebRTC wrapper with a Node stream interface.

localizedSummary.en: Minimal WebRTC wrapper with a Node stream interface.
localizedSummary.ru: Минималистичная обёртка WebRTC с интерфейсом потоков Node.

localizedTip.en: Small enough to read completely, which helps a great deal when debugging WebRTC negotiation.

items.name: Docling
items.summary: Turns PDFs, DOCX and slides into structured, chunk-ready document trees.

localizedSummary.ru: Превращает PDF, DOCX и презентации в структурированные деревья, готовые к чанкованию.

items.name: jsPDF
items.summary: Client-side PDF generation directly in the browser with a simple imperative API.

items.name: LlamaParse
items.summary: Document parsing service tuned for complex PDFs with tables and multi-column layouts.

localizedSummary.en: Document parsing service tuned for complex PDFs with tables and multi-column layouts.
localizedSummary.ru: Сервис разбора документов, настроенный на сложные PDF с таблицами и многоколоночной вёрсткой.

items.name: MarkItDown
items.summary: Microsoft's converter turning Office documents, PDFs and more into Markdown for LLMs.

localizedSummary.ru: Конвертер Microsoft, превращающий документы Office, PDF и другие форматы в Markdown для LLM.

items.name: pdf-lib

localizedSummary.en: Create and modify PDFs in JavaScript, in the browser or Node, including form fields.

items.name: pdfmake
items.summary: Declarative PDF generation from a JSON document definition, good for reports and invoices.
items.tip: The document definition is plain JSON, which makes generating a PDF from server data a direct mapping.

localizedSummary.en: Declarative PDF generation from a JSON document definition, good for reports and invoices.
localizedSummary.ru: Декларативная генерация PDF из JSON-описания документа, удобно для отчётов и счетов.

localizedTip.en: The document definition is plain JSON, which makes generating a PDF from server data a direct mapping.

items.name: PyMuPDF

items.name: pypdf

localizedSummary.ru: Чтение, слияние, разделение и правка метаданных PDF на чистом Python.

localizedTip.en: Fine for structure work; for scanned pages you still need OCR in front of it.

items.name: Reducto
items.summary: High-accuracy document parsing aimed at complex financial and scientific documents.

localizedSummary.en: High-accuracy document parsing aimed at complex financial and scientific documents.
localizedSummary.ru: Высокоточный разбор документов для сложных финансовых и научных материалов.

localizedTip.en: Priced per page and aimed at cases where a parsing error carries real financial consequence.

items.name: WeasyPrint
items.summary: Renders HTML and CSS to PDF with real support for print stylesheets.
items.tip: Paged-media CSS gives you headers, footers and page numbers without a template engine.

localizedSummary.en: Renders HTML and CSS to PDF with real support for print stylesheets.

localizedTip.en: Paged-media CSS gives you headers, footers and page numbers without a template engine.

items.name: Bevy
items.summary: Data-driven Rust game engine built around an entity-component-system architecture.

localizedSummary.en: Data-driven Rust game engine built around an entity-component-system architecture.
localizedSummary.ru: Rust-движок для игр, построенный на архитектуре entity-component-system.

localizedTip.en: The ECS model rewards designing data and systems before writing any gameplay code.

items.name: Defold
items.summary: Free, lightweight 2D engine scripted in Lua, with small build sizes across platforms.

items.name: Excalibur.js

items.name: Godot Engine

localizedSummary.en: Fully free, MIT-licensed game engine with a friendly scripting language and no royalties.

items.name: KAPLAY (Kaboom.js)

localizedSummary.en: 2D rigid body physics engine for the browser.

localizedTip.en: Tune the timestep carefully — physics engines behave very differently on inconsistent frame rates.

items.name: Unity
items.summary: Industry-standard engine for 2D, 3D and mixed-reality games with a huge asset ecosystem.

localizedSummary.en: Industry-standard engine for 2D, 3D and mixed-reality games with a huge asset ecosystem.
localizedSummary.ru: Индустриальный стандарт для 2D, 3D и mixed-reality игр с огромной экосистемой ассетов.

items.name: Unreal Engine

items.name: Phaser

items.name: Fastlane
